title: MSFS Marketplace Update (PC) – New Boeing 747 KLM Missions & Winter 2025 Activities!
description:
MSFS Marketplace Update (Feb 28, 2026): New Microsoft Flight Simulator Missions, Boeing 747 KLM Mission Pack, and MSFS PC Activities are live! This MSFS Marketplace Update features new Grand Tours.

This week’s Microsoft Flight Simulator Marketplace Update (PC) is packed with new activities. From the Perfect Flight Boeing 747 KLM mission pack to Winter 2025 Airline Schedules, this MSFS PC Update brings essential new content to your simulator.

🗺️ New activities added this week (PC)
The following activity (missions & miscellaneous) was newly released in the marketplace this week:

🗺️ Koschi: Unique Places – Part 6 (exploration-focused landmark missions)
🗺️ Koschi: Unique Places – Part 7 (new handcrafted routes and destinations)
🗺️ Perfect Flight: 4AIR MISSIONS – 747 KLM (classic long‑haul Boeing 747 airline operations)
🗺️ Perfect Flight: 8LEGS GRAND TOUR – CARIBBEAN (multi‑leg regional adventure tour)
🗺️ Perfect Flight: Above The Sky – Yosemite National Park (scenic VFR-focused experience)
🗺️ Simple Missions: Simple CargoAir3 Missions Bundle (structured cargo flying challenges)
🗺️ VA SYSTEMS: Airline Schedules – Winter 2025 Series (real‑world airline timetables)
🗺️ VA SYSTEMS: Airport Schedules – Winter 2025 Series (airport‑specific traffic schedules)

If you enjoy realistic airline operations, structured missions, or just want more purpose in your flights, this week’s PC update has something for every type of simmer.
If this video helps you stay on top of the Marketplace, don’t forget to 👍 like, 🔔 subscribe, and drop a comment below with which activity you’re flying first!

Thanks for watching and supporting the channel 
✈️ See you in the skies!
